O’Neill’s 1001 tune index

A searchable index of all 1001 tunes in Francis O’Neill’s The Dance Music of Ireland: 1001 Gems (Chicago, 1907) — the double jigs, single and slip jigs, reels, hornpipes and set dances that became the backbone of the Irish session repertoire. Search by any of the book’s titles, sort by number to browse it in order, and open any tune for O’Neill’s own setting with playback.

969 tunes link to their page on thesession.org, where many go by other names — those are shown under the title.
